title: Bezel Set Cabochon
lede: low or full bezel for cabochons.
weightNote: For the light shank. Working weight, until a finished ring is weighed.
stone: Cabochons, including ovals and less regular shapes. Faceted stones use the traditional bezel.
about: This setting holds a cabochon in a low bezel. A metal rim follows the outline of the stone and protects the edge. The ring stays low on the hand. The shape can follow an oval or a less regular cabochon.

points.name: Unique shapes.
points.text: The bezel follows the cabochon, so the stone does not have to be a standard round or oval.

points.name: Fully protected.
points.text: The metal rim covers the edge of the stone.

points.name: Low profile.
points.text: The setting stays low, so the ring wears close to the hand.

media.caption: Cantera opal on a light shank, 2.95 mm wide and 1.5 mm thick, with decorative shoulders.

media.caption: Azurite, with decorative shoulders.

media.caption: Pink and blue cabochons on heavy shanks, 3.5 mm wide and 2.25 mm thick.

priceNote: This is an estimate based on the design and the metal weight. Prices fluctuate with the metal price, the size of the piece, and the options.

choices.name: Light
choices.detail: 3 mm or less wide, about 1.5 mm thick. The sterling weight is for this shank.

choices.name: Heavy
choices.detail: Wider than 3 mm, about 2 mm thick.

choices.name: Decorative
choices.detail: Stacked rings where the bezel meets the shank.

fingerSize: Finger size is required with every order. Ask for it when the setting is written down.
leadTime: The setting is made to order once the stone is chosen. Allow 2 weeks for fabrication.
open: Weigh a finished silver ring with the light shank. It is 2.5 g for now.
